pages.title: Our History
pages.text_en: Moshi District Council was established in January, 1984 by provisions of section 8 and 9 of the Local Government (District Authorities) Act 1982 with 45 Councilors in Number, of which 27 were elected, 1 each from the Wards within the Council, 5 were elected by the Council from the persons nominated by party Organizations and 3 were appointed by the Minister .1 Member of Parliament represented the consistency (Moshi Rural) and 9 were elected by the Council from amongst the villages Chairmen.
pages.text_sw: Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Moshi iliundwa Januari, 1984 kwa mujibu wa kifungu cha 8 na 9 cha Sheria ya Serikali za Mitaa (Mamlaka za Wilaya) ya 1982 ikiwa na wanachama 45, kati yao 27 walioteuliwa kwa kupigiwa kura, mmoja kutoka kila kata ndani ya Halmashauri, 5 walioteuliwa na Halmashauri kutoka kwa watu waliopendekezwa na mashirika ya vyama vya siasa, na 3 walioteuliwa na Waziri. Mbunge mmoja aliwakilisha jimbo la Moshi Vijijini na 9 walioteuliwa na Halmashauri kutoka kati ya wakuu wa vijiji.

pages.menu_path: About Us > Vision and Mission > Vision and Mission
pages.title: Vision and Mission
pages.text_en:
Vision
To be a council with stable economy and efficient services delivery for improved
community livelihood.
Mission
To provide quality socio-economic services through proper utilization of available
resources for improving community livelihood.
pages.text_sw:
Dira
Kuwa Halmashauri yenye Uchumi imara na yenye utoaji wa huduma bora kwa ajili ya uboreshaji wa maisha ya jamii.
Dhamira
Kutoa huduma bora za kiuchumi na kijamii kwa kuwa na matumizi sahihi ya rasilimali zilizopo ili kuboresha maisha ya jamii.

pages.menu_path: About Us > Core Value > Core Value
pages.title: Core Value
pages.text_en: Integrity, High Commitment in Service Delivery, Accountability, Teamwork Spirit, and Efficiency and Effectiveness in the Use of Available Resources, which collectively underpin ethical conduct, professionalism, transparency, and results-oriented public service delivery.
pages.text_sw: Uadilifu, Dhamira kubwa katika utoaji huduma,Uwajibikaji, Kufanya kazi kwa pamoja na Ufanisi katika matumizi ya rasilimali zilizopo kwa kuzingatia miongozo ya kimaadili ambayo ni weledi, uwazi, na utoaji wa huduma za umma zinazolenga matokeo.

pages.title: Human Resource Management and Administration Division

pages.menu_path: Administration > Division > Planning and Coordination Division
pages.title: Planning and Coordination Division
pages.text_en:
Objective
To provide expertise and services in planning, budgeting, monitoring, and evaluation within the Local Government Authority (LGA).
Functions of the Division
The Division shall perform the following functions:
Prepare mid-term and long-term strategies, plans, and budgets.
Monitor and evaluate the implementation of strategies, plans, and budgets.
Prepare and review the LGA’s socio-economic profile.
Coordinate private sector participation initiatives.
Coordinate data collection, analysis, interpretation, and storage within the LGA.
Provide technical advice on monitoring and evaluation processes.
Coordinate Council Disaster Management activities.
Coordinate LGA activities implemented by other institutions, such as those related to land and water.
Structure of the Division
The Division will be headed by a Head of Division and will comprise two (2) sections:
Planning and Budgeting Section
Monitoring and Evaluation Section
Planning and Budgeting Section
Functions
The Planning and Budgeting Section shall perform the following activities:
Coordinate implementation of economic and productive sector policies.
Interpret and disseminate policies from the Central Government and sector ministries to the LGA.
Coordinate mid-year and annual performance reviews.
Coordinate the formulation and preparation of LGA plans and budgets.
Compile reports on projects, programmes, and action plans and develop strategies for resource mobilization.
Provide technical guidance and support to institutionalize the strategic planning and budgeting process within the LGA.
Coordinate preparation of reports on the implementation of the Ruling Party Manifesto.
This section will be led by an Officer in Charge.
Monitoring and Evaluation Section
Functions
The Monitoring and Evaluation Section shall perform the following activities:
Monitor and evaluate the implementation of LGA plans.
Prepare periodic performance reports.
Provide inputs in the preparation of plans, programmes, and budgets, including the establishment of performance targets and indicators.
Provide technical advice on monitoring and evaluation processes.
Conduct impact studies on plans, projects, and programmes undertaken by the LGA.
Coordinate the production of routine data and statistics across all sectors.
Collaborate with the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) in data collection, coding/entry, analysis, and interpretation.
Coordinate the preparation and dissemination of socio-economic profiles.
Develop and design data collection instruments.
Provide statistical support during planning and budget preparation.
Coordinate implementation of performance contracting.
Conduct service delivery surveys.
This section will also be led by an Officer in Charge.
pages.text_sw:
Lengo
Kutoa utaalamu na huduma katika mipango, uandaaji wa bajeti, ufuatiliaji na tathmini ndani ya Mamlaka ya Serikali za Mitaa (LGA).
Majukumu ya Kitengo
Kitengo hiki kitafanya majukumu yafuatayo:
Kuandaa mikakati, mipango na bajeti ya muda wa kati na muda mrefu.
Kufuatilia na kutathmini utekelezaji wa mikakati, mipango na bajeti.
Kuandaa na kupitia wasifu wa kijamii na kiuchumi wa Halmashauri.
Kuratibu ushiriki wa sekta binafsi katika shughuli za maendeleo.
Kuratibu ukusanyaji, uchambuzi, tafsiri na uhifadhi wa takwimu za Halmashauri.
Kutoa ushauri wa kitaalamu kuhusu ufuatiliaji na tathmini.
Kuratibu usimamizi wa maafa wa Halmashauri.
Kuratibu shughuli za Halmashauri zinazotekelezwa na taasisi nyingine, kama vile sekta za ardhi na maji.
Muundo wa Kitengo
Kitengo hiki kitaongozwa na Mkuu wa Kitengo na kitakuwa na sehemu mbili (2) zifuatazo:
Sehemu ya Mipango na Bajeti
Sehemu ya Ufuatiliaji na Tathmini
S ehemu ya Mipango na Bajeti
Majukumu
Sehemu hii itafanya shughuli zifuatazo:
Kuratibu utekelezaji wa sera za sekta za uchumi na uzalishaji.
Kutafsiri na kusambaza sera kutoka Serikali Kuu na Wizara za kisekta kwa Halmashauri.
Kuratibu mapitio ya utendaji ya katikati ya mwaka na ya kila mwaka.
Kuratibu uundaji na uandaaji wa mipango na bajeti za Halmashauri.
Kukusanya taarifa za miradi, programu na mipango ya utekelezaji, pamoja na kuandaa mikakati ya upatikanaji wa rasilimali.
Kutoa mwongozo wa kitaalamu katika kuimarisha mchakato wa mipango ya kimkakati na uandaaji wa bajeti ndani ya Halmashauri.
Kuratibu uandaaji wa taarifa za utekelezaji wa Ilani ya Chama Tawala.
Sehemu hii itaongozwa na Afisa Anayesimamia (Officer in Charge).
Sehemu ya Ufuatiliaji na Tathmini
Majukumu
Sehemu hii itafanya shughuli zifuatazo:
Kufuatilia na kutathmini utekelezaji wa mipango ya Halmashauri.
Kuandaa taarifa za utendaji za mara kwa mara.
Kutoa mchango katika uandaaji wa mipango, programu na bajeti, ikiwemo kuweka malengo na viashiria vya utendaji.
Kutoa ushauri wa kitaalamu kuhusu mifumo ya ufuatiliaji na tathmini.
Kufanya tafiti za athari (impact studies) za mipango, miradi na programu zinazotekelezwa na Halmashauri.
Kuratibu uzalishaji wa takwimu za kawaida katika sekta zote.
Kushirikiana na Ofisi ya Taifa ya Takwimu (NBS) katika ukusanyaji, uingizaji wa takwimu, uchambuzi na tafsiri ya data.
Kuratibu uandaaji na usambazaji wa wasifu wa kijamii na kiuchumi.
Kuandaa na kubuni zana za ukusanyaji wa data.
Kutoa msaada wa kitaalamu wa takwimu wakati wa uandaaji wa mipango na bajeti.
Kuratibu utekelezaji wa mikataba ya utendaji kazi (performance contracting).
Kufanya tafiti za utoaji wa huduma kwa wananchi (service delivery surveys).
Sehemu hii pia itaongozwa na Afisa Anayesimamia.

pages.title: Health, Social Welfare and Nutrition Services Division
pages.text_en:
Objective
To provide quality health, social welfare, and nutrition services for the well-being of the community.
Functions of the Division
The Division performs the following functions:
To supervise the implementation of policies, laws, and procedures related to health, social welfare, and nutrition services.
To prepare short-term and long-term plans and programs for the health sector within the Council.
To promote the participation of various stakeholders in health, social welfare, and nutrition activities.
To prepare and submit reports on health, social welfare, and nutrition services to relevant authorities.
To develop strategies for controlling communicable and non-communicable diseases.
To manage health, social welfare, and nutrition projects.
To manage databases related to health, social welfare, and nutrition services.
Structure of the Division
The Division is led by a Head , who also serves as the Council Medical Officer of Health (CMoH) .
The Division consists of three (3) sections:
Health Services Section
Social Welfare Section
Nutrition Services Section
Health Services Section
This section performs the following activities:
Analyze, interpret, and supervise the implementation of policies, laws, and procedures related to health services.
Provide advice on coordination and capacity building in health services.
Prepare short-term and long-term plans and programs for health services.
Provide technical advice to stakeholders on health service issues.
Conduct epidemiological monitoring and evaluation, and prevent communicable, non-communicable, and emerging diseases in health facilities, communities, and entry points.
This section is led by an Officer in Charge .
Social Welfare Section
This section performs the following activities:
Analyze, interpret, and manage the implementation of policies, laws, and procedures for improving social welfare.
Prepare short-term and long-term plans and projects for social welfare.
Supervise the implementation of social welfare plans and projects.
Coordinate and manage all projects related to social welfare.
Prepare reports related to social welfare.
This section is led by an Officer in Charge .
Nutrition Services Section
This section performs the following activities:
Analyze, interpret, and manage the implementation of policies, laws, and procedures related to nutrition improvement.
Prepare short-term and long-term plans and projects for nutrition.
Supervise the implementation of nutrition plans and projects.
Coordinate and manage all projects related to nutrition.
Prepare reports related to nutrition.
Educate and sensitize the community on nutrition issues.
Monitor and evaluate the provision of nutrition services within the Council.
Collect and analyze reports related to nutrition services.
Provide nutrition services to children, adults, and people with special needs.
This section is led by an Officer in Charge .
pages.text_sw:
Lengo
Kutoa huduma bora za afya, ustawi wa jamii na lishe kwa ajili ya ustawi wa jamii.
Majukumu ya Idara
Idara itatekeleza majukumu yafuatayo:
Kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria na taratibu zinazohusu utoaji wa huduma za afya, ustawi wa jamii na lishe.
Kuandaa mipango na programu za muda mfupi na muda mrefu kwa sekta ya afya katika Halmashauri.
Kuhamasisha ushiriki wa wadau mbalimbali katika shughuli za afya, ustawi wa jamii na lishe.
Kuandaa na kuwasilisha taarifa kuhusu huduma za afya, ustawi wa jamii na lishe kwa mamlaka husika.
Kuandaa mikakati ya kudhibiti magonjwa ya kuambukiza na yasiyo ya kuambukiza.
Kusimamia miradi ya afya, ustawi wa jamii na lishe.
Kusimamia hifadhidata (database) ya taarifa zinazohusiana na huduma za afya, ustawi wa jamii na lishe.
Muundo wa Idara
Idara hii itaongozwa na Mkuu wa Idara , ambaye pia atakuwa Mganga Mkuu wa Halmashauri (Council Medical Officer of Health – CMoH) .
Idara itakuwa na sehemu tatu (3) zifuatazo:
Sehemu ya Huduma za Afya
Sehemu ya Ustawi wa Jamii
Sehemu ya Huduma za Lishe
Sehemu ya Huduma za Afya
Sehemu hii itatekeleza shughuli zifuatazo:
Kuchambua, kutafsiri na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria na taratibu za huduma za afya.
Kutoa ushauri kuhusu uratibu na uimarishaji wa uwezo katika huduma za afya.
Kuandaa mipango na programu za muda mfupi na muda mrefu kwa huduma za afya.
Kutoa ushauri wa kitaalamu kwa wadau kuhusu masuala ya huduma za afya.
Kufanya ufuatiliaji na tathmini ya magonjwa (epidemiolojia), pamoja na kuzuia magonjwa yasiyo ya kuambukiza, ya kuambukiza na magonjwa mapya katika vituo vya afya, jamii na maeneo ya kuingilia nchini.
Sehemu hii itaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu (Officer in Charge).
Sehemu ya Ustawi wa Jamii
Sehemu hii itatekeleza shughuli zifuatazo:
Kuchambua, kutafsiri na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria na taratibu za kuboresha ustawi wa jamii.
Kuandaa mipango na miradi ya muda mfupi na muda mrefu ya ustawi wa jamii.
Kusimamia utekelezaji wa mipango na miradi ya ustawi wa jamii.
Kuratibu na kusimamia miradi yote inayohusiana na ustawi wa jamii.
Kuandaa taarifa zinazohusiana na ustawi wa jamii.
Sehemu hii itaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu.
Sehemu ya Huduma za Lishe
Sehemu hii itatekeleza shughuli zifuatazo:
Kuchambua, kutafsiri na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria na taratibu za kuboresha lishe.
Kuandaa mipango na miradi ya muda mfupi na muda mrefu ya lishe.
Kusimamia utekelezaji wa mipango na miradi ya lishe.
Kuratibu na kusimamia miradi yote inayohusiana na lishe.
Kuandaa taarifa zinazohusiana na lishe.
Kuelimisha jamii kuhusu masuala ya lishe.
Kufuatilia na kutathmini utoaji wa huduma za lishe katika Halmashauri.
Kukusanya na kuchambua taarifa za huduma za lishe.
Kutoa huduma za lishe kwa watoto, watu wazima na watu wenye mahitaji maalum.
Sehemu hii itaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu.

pages.title: Pre-Primary and Primary Education Division
pages.text_en:
Objective
To plan and supervise the implementation of policies, laws, and circulars related to the provision of pre-primary, primary, special needs, and non-formal education.
Functions of the Division
The Division performs the following functions:
Plan for the acquisition, distribution, and use of resources in primary schools.
Supervise the administration of continuous assessments and national examinations for primary schools.
Supervise the delivery of adult and non-formal education at the pre-primary and primary levels.
Coordinate life skills education in primary schools.
Conduct needs assessments for special needs education, adult education, and non-formal education.
Provide advice on the establishment and maintenance of special needs, adult, and non-formal education centers.
Monitor the implementation of primary education plans and programs.
Create and maintain databases for pre-primary and primary education.
Coordinate and supervise sports and games activities in primary schools.
Structure of the Division
The Division is led by a Head and consists of four (4) sections:
Academic Section
Statistics and Logistics Section
Special Needs Education Section
Adult and Non-Formal Education Section
Academic Section
This section performs the following activities:
Coordinate the implementation of pre-primary and primary education policies, plans, circulars, and guidelines at the school level.
Coordinate and supervise the administration of continuous assessments and national Standard Four and Standard Seven examinations.
Monitor and evaluate the implementation of pre-primary and primary education plans.
Prepare reports on the implementation of education development plans and programs.
Coordinate the provision of education for self-reliance and manage income-generating activities or projects in primary schools.
This section is led by an Officer in Charge .
Statistics and Logistics Section
This section performs the following activities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret statistics related to pre-primary and primary education.
Coordinate the acquisition, distribution, and use of educational resources in primary schools.
Coordinate enrollment statistics and logistics for schools.
Prepare implementation reports on education development.
Determine resource needs for schools in the Council.
This section is led by an Officer in Charge .
Special Needs Education Section
This section performs the following activities:
Prepare and supervise special needs education implementation plans for primary education.
Identify children with special needs and allocate them to appropriate schools.
Collect information on pupils with special needs and provide appropriate advice.
Coordinate the acquisition, distribution, and use of resources for special needs education.
This section is led by an Officer in Charge .
Adult and Non-Formal Education Section
This section performs the following activities:
Prepare and supervise adult and non-formal education implementation plans for primary education.
Coordinate life skills education.
Conduct needs assessments for adult and non-formal education.
Provide advice on the establishment and maintenance of adult and non-formal training centers.
Coordinate the acquisition, distribution, and use of resources for adult and non-formal education.
This section is led by an Officer in Charge .
pages.text_sw:
Lengo
Kupanga na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria na waraka (circulars) zinazohusu utoaji wa elimu ya awali, elimu ya msingi, elimu maalum na elimu isiyo rasmi.
Majukumu ya Idara
Idara itatekeleza majukumu yafuatayo:
Kupanga upatikanaji, usambazaji na matumizi ya rasilimali katika shule za msingi.
Kusimamia uendeshaji wa tathmini endelevu (continuous assessment) na mitihani ya taifa ya shule za msingi.
Kusimamia utoaji wa elimu ya watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi katika ngazi ya elimu ya awali na msingi.
Kuratibu utoaji wa elimu ya stadi za maisha katika shule za msingi.
Kufanya tathmini ya mahitaji ya elimu maalum, elimu ya watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi.
Kutoa ushauri kuhusu uanzishaji na uendeshaji wa vituo vya elimu maalum, elimu ya watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi.
Kufuatilia utekelezaji wa mipango na programu za elimu ya msingi.
Kuunda na kutunza hifadhidata ya elimu ya awali na msingi.
Kuratibu na kusimamia shughuli za michezo na michezo ya shule za msingi.
Muundo wa Idara
Idara itaongozwa na Mkuu wa Idara na itakuwa na sehemu nne (4) zifuatazo:
Sehemu ya Taaluma (Academic Section)
Sehemu ya Takwimu na Ugavi (Statistics and Logistics Section)
Sehemu ya Elimu Maalum (Special Needs Education Section)
Sehemu ya Elimu ya Watu Wazima na Elimu Isiyo Rasmi (Adult and Non-Formal Education Section)
Sehemu ya Taaluma
Sehemu hii itafanya shughuli zifuatazo:
Kuratibu utekelezaji wa sera, mipango, waraka na miongozo ya elimu ya awali na msingi katika ngazi ya shule.
Kuratibu na kusimamia uendeshaji wa tathmini endelevu za shule pamoja na mitihani ya taifa ya darasa la nne na darasa la saba.
Kufuatilia na kutathmini utekelezaji wa mipango ya elimu ya awali na msingi.
Kuandaa taarifa za utekelezaji wa mipango na programu za maendeleo ya elimu.
Kuratibu utoaji wa elimu ya kujitegemea na usimamizi wa shughuli au miradi ya kuzalisha kipato katika shule za msingi.
Sehemu hii itaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu (Officer in Charge).
Sehemu ya Takwimu na Ugavi
Sehemu hii itafanya shughuli zifuatazo:
Kukusanya, kuchambua na kutafsiri takwimu za elimu ya awali na msingi.
Kuratibu upatikanaji, usambazaji na matumizi ya rasilimali za elimu katika shule za msingi.
Kuratibu takwimu za uandikishaji wa wanafunzi na ugavi wa vifaa shuleni.
Kuandaa taarifa za utekelezaji wa maendeleo ya elimu.
Kubaini mahitaji ya rasilimali kwa shule zilizo katika Halmashauri.
Sehemu hii itaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu.
Sehemu ya Elimu Maalum
Sehemu hii itafanya shughuli zifuatazo:
Kuandaa na kusimamia mipango ya utekelezaji wa elimu maalum katika elimu ya msingi.
Kutambua watoto wenye mahitaji maalum na kuwapeleka katika shule husika.
Kukusanya taarifa za wanafunzi wenye mahitaji maalum na kutoa ushauri unaofaa.
Kuratibu upatikanaji, usambazaji na matumizi ya rasilimali kwa ajili ya elimu maalum.
Sehemu hii itaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu.
Sehemu ya Elimu ya Watu Wazima na Elimu Isiyo Rasmi
Sehemu hii itafanya shughuli zifuatazo:
Kuandaa na kusimamia mipango ya utekelezaji wa elimu ya watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi katika elimu ya msingi.
Kuratibu utoaji wa elimu ya stadi za maisha.
Kufanya tathmini ya mahitaji ya elimu ya watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi.
Kutoa ushauri kuhusu uanzishaji na uendeshaji wa vituo vya mafunzo ya elimu ya watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi.
Kuratibu upatikanaji, usambazaji na matumizi ya rasilimali kwa ajili ya elimu ya watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi.
Sehemu hii itaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu.

pages.title: Secondary Education Division
pages.text_en:
Objective
To coordinate the implementation of secondary education policies, plans, laws, circulars, and guidelines.
Functions of the Division
The Division performs the following functions:
Supervise the administration of continuous assessments and national Form Two, Form Four, and Form Six examinations.
Conduct monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of secondary education plans and programs.
Supervise the delivery of adult and non-formal education at the secondary level.
Create and maintain a database on secondary education.
Coordinate life skills education in secondary schools.
Coordinate and supervise sports and games in secondary schools.
Conduct needs assessments for special needs education, adult education, and non-formal education.
Provide advice on the establishment and maintenance of special needs, adult, and non-formal education centers.
Structure of the Division
The Division is led by a Head and consists of four (4) sections:
Academic Section
Statistics and Logistics Section
Special Needs Education Section
Adult and Non-Formal Education Section
Academic Section
This section performs the following activities:
Supervise the implementation of secondary education policies, plans, circulars, and guidelines in secondary schools.
Supervise the improvement of academic performance in secondary schools.
Coordinate and supervise the administration of continuous assessments and national Form Two, Form Four, and Form Six examinations.
Monitor and evaluate the implementation of secondary education plans and assess their strengths and weaknesses.
Coordinate and supervise sports and games in secondary schools.
This section is led by an Officer in Charge .
Statistics and Logistics Section
This section performs the following activities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret statistics related to secondary education.
Coordinate the acquisition, distribution, and use of educational resources in secondary schools.
Coordinate enrollment statistics and logistics for schools.
Prepare implementation reports on education development.
Determine resource needs for schools within the Council.
This section is led by an Officer in Charge .
Special Needs Education Section
This section performs the following activities:
Prepare and supervise special needs education implementation plans for secondary education.
Identify children with special needs and allocate them to appropriate schools.
Collect information on students with special needs and provide appropriate advice.
Coordinate the acquisition, distribution, and use of resources for special needs education.
This section is led by an Officer in Charge .
Adult and Non-Formal Education Section
This section performs the following activities:
Prepare and supervise adult and non-formal education implementation plans for secondary education.
Coordinate life skills education.
Conduct needs assessments for adult and non-formal education.
Provide advice on the establishment and maintenance of adult and non-formal education centers.
Coordinate the acquisition, distribution, and use of resources for adult and non-formal education.
This section is led by an Officer in Charge .
pages.text_sw:
Lengo
Kuratibu utekelezaji wa sera, mipango, sheria, waraka (circulars) na miongozo ya elimu ya sekondari.
Majukumu ya Idara
Idara itatekeleza majukumu yafuatayo:
Kusimamia uendeshaji wa tathmini endelevu na mitihani ya taifa ya darasa la pili (Form Two), la nne (Form Four) na la sita (Form Six).
Kufanya ufuatiliaji na tathmini ya utekelezaji wa mipango na programu za elimu ya sekondari.
Kusimamia utoaji wa elimu ya watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi katika ngazi ya sekondari.
Kuunda na kutunza hifadhidata ya elimu ya sekondari.
Kuratibu elimu ya stadi za maisha katika shule za sekondari.
Kuratibu na kusimamia michezo na shughuli za michezo shuleni.
Kufanya tathmini ya mahitaji ya elimu maalum, elimu ya watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi.
Kutoa ushauri kuhusu uanzishaji na uendeshaji wa vituo vya elimu maalum, elimu ya watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi.
Muundo wa Idara
Idara itaongozwa na Mkuu wa Idara na itakuwa na sehemu nne (4):
Sehemu ya Taaluma (Academic Section)
Sehemu ya Takwimu na Ugavi (Statistics and Logistics Section)
Sehemu ya Elimu Maalum (Special Needs Education Section)
Sehemu ya Elimu ya Watu Wazima na Isiyo Rasmi (Adult and Non-Formal Education Section)
Sehemu ya Taaluma
Sehemu hii itafanya shughuli zifuatazo:
Kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, mipango, waraka na miongozo ya elimu ya sekondari katika shule za sekondari.
Kusimamia maendeleo ya utendaji wa kitaaluma katika shule za sekondari.
Kuratibu na kusimamia uendeshaji wa tathmini endelevu na mitihani ya taifa ya Form Two, Form Four na Form Six.
Kufuatilia na kutathmini utekelezaji wa mipango ya elimu ya sekondari na kubaini nguvu na udhaifu wake.
Kuratibu na kusimamia michezo na shughuli za michezo katika shule za sekondari.
Sehemu hii itaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu (Officer in Charge).
Sehemu ya Takwimu na Ugavi
Sehemu hii itafanya shughuli zifuatazo:
Kukusanya, kuchambua na kutafsiri takwimu za elimu ya sekondari.
Kuratibu upatikanaji, usambazaji na matumizi ya rasilimali za elimu katika shule za sekondari.
Kuratibu takwimu za uandikishaji wa wanafunzi na ugavi wa vifaa shuleni.
Kuandaa taarifa za utekelezaji wa maendeleo ya elimu.
Kubaini mahitaji ya rasilimali kwa shule zilizoko katika Halmashauri.
Sehemu hii itaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu.
Sehemu ya Elimu Maalum
Sehemu hii itafanya shughuli zifuatazo:
Kuandaa na kusimamia mipango ya utekelezaji wa elimu maalum katika elimu ya sekondari.
Kutambua watoto wenye mahitaji maalum na kuwapeleka katika shule husika.
Kukusanya taarifa za wanafunzi wenye mahitaji maalum na kutoa ushauri unaofaa.
Kuratibu upatikanaji, usambazaji na matumizi ya rasilimali kwa ajili ya elimu maalum.
Sehemu hii itaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu.
Sehemu ya Elimu ya Watu Wazima na Isiyo Rasmi
Sehemu hii itafanya shughuli zifuatazo:
Kuandaa na kusimamia mipango ya utekelezaji wa elimu ya watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi katika elimu ya sekondari.
Kuratibu elimu ya stadi za maisha.
Kufanya tathmini ya mahitaji ya elimu ya watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi.
Kutoa ushauri kuhusu uanzishaji na uendeshaji wa vituo vya mafunzo ya watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi.
Kuratibu upatikanaji, usambazaji na matumizi ya rasilimali kwa ajili ya elimu ya watu wazima na isiyo rasmi.
Sehemu hii itaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu.

pages.title: Community Development Division
pages.text_en:
Objective
To supervise community development activities within the Local Government Authority (LGA).
Main Functions of the Division
The Division performs several key responsibilities:
Policy Implementation
Analyze, interpret, and supervise the implementation of policies, laws, and procedures related to community development.
Community Empowerment
Facilitate communities to initiate, plan, implement, and evaluate their own development programs and projects.
Planning
Prepare short-term and long-term community development plans and projects at the LGA level.
Research and Problem Solving
Conduct research and recommend solutions to development challenges in collaboration with the Ministry responsible for community development and other stakeholders.
Microfinance Regulation
Regulate and supervise Tier 4 microfinance service providers according to directives from the Bank of Tanzania.
Economic Empowerment
Coordinate economic development activities for:
Women
Children
Persons with disabilities
Training and Social Programs
Coordinate training programs on:
Poverty alleviation
HIV/AIDS awareness
Drug abuse prevention
Gender equality
NGOs and CBOs Coordination
Monitor and coordinate activities of Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs) and Community-Based Organizations (CBOs) involved in community development.
General Coordination
Manage and coordinate all community development activities within the LGA.
Structure of the Community Development Division
The Division is headed by a Head of Division and consists of two sections:
Cross-cutting Issues Coordination Section
NGOs and CBOs Coordination Section
Cross-cutting Issues Coordination Section
Main Activities
This section focuses on policy implementation, social development, and community participation.
Key activities include:
Analyzing and supervising community development policies and laws.
Supervising implementation of community development plans and projects.
Preparing short- and long-term development plans.
Conducting research on development challenges.
Coordinating development programs for:
Women
Children
Persons with disabilities
Coordinating training programs related to:
Poverty reduction
HIV/AIDS awareness
Drug abuse prevention
Gender equality
Promoting community participation and volunteerism in development projects.
Conducting community awareness and sensitization programs.
Encouraging community involvement in:
Planning
Decision-making
Implementation
Evaluation of projects.
Researching factors that hinder community development.
This section is led by an Officer in Charge.
NGOs and CBOs Coordination Section
Main Activities
This section focuses on partnerships, monitoring organizations, and managing development projects.
Key responsibilities include:
Coordinating registration and monitoring of NGOs and CBOs.
Providing citizenship education to the community.
Establishing partnerships with local and international organizations working on community development.
Coordinating and managing community development projects.
Managing agreements related to community development activities.
Preparing regular community development reports.
Supervising Tier 4 microfinance service providers according to directives from the Bank of Tanzania.
This section is also led by an Officer in Charge.
pages.text_sw:
Lengo
Lengo kuu la kitengo hiki ni kusimamia shughuli za maendeleo ya jamii katika Halmashauri ya Serikali za Mitaa (LGA).
Majukumu ya Kitengo
Kitengo hiki kinafanya majukumu yafuatayo:
Kuchambua na kusimamia sera
Kuchambua, kufasiri na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria na taratibu zinazohusu maendeleo ya jamii.
Kuwezesha jamii
Kusaidia jamii kuanzisha, kupanga, kutekeleza na kutathmini programu na miradi yao ya maendeleo.
Mipango ya maendeleo
Kuandaa mipango ya muda mfupi na muda mrefu ya maendeleo ya jamii katika ngazi ya Halmashauri.
Utafiti wa maendeleo
Kufanya tafiti na kutoa mapendekezo ya namna ya kutatua changamoto mbalimbali za maendeleo kwa kushirikiana na Wizara husika na wadau wengine.
Usimamizi wa huduma ndogo za kifedha
Kusimamia na kudhibiti watoa huduma wa microfinance wa daraja la nne (Tier 4) kwa kufuata maelekezo ya Bank of Tanzania.
Maendeleo ya makundi maalum
Kuratibu shughuli za maendeleo ya kiuchumi kwa:
Wanawake
Watoto
Watu wenye ulemavu
Mafunzo kwa jamii
Kuratibu mafunzo kuhusu:
Kupunguza umaskini
UKIMWI
Matumizi ya dawa za kulevya
Usawa wa kijinsia
Uratibu wa NGOs na CBOs
Kuratibu na kufuatilia shughuli za NGOs na CBOs zinazofanya kazi za maendeleo ya jamii.
Uratibu wa shughuli za maendeleo
Kuratibu na kusimamia shughuli zote za maendeleo ya jamii katika Halmashauri.
Muundo wa Kitengo
Kitengo hiki kinaongozwa na Mkuu wa Kitengo na kina sehemu mbili kuu:
Sehemu ya Uratibu wa Masuala Mtambuka
Sehemu ya Uratibu wa NGOs na CBOs
1. Sehemu ya Uratibu wa Masuala Mtambuka
( Cross-cutting Issues Coordination Section )
Majukumu yake ni pamoja na:
Kuchambua na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera na sheria za maendeleo ya jamii.
Kusimamia utekelezaji wa mipango na miradi ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Kuandaa mipango ya muda mfupi na muda mrefu ya maendeleo.
Kufanya tafiti kuhusu changamoto za maendeleo.
Kuratibu maendeleo ya:
Wanawake
Watoto
Watu wenye ulemavu
Kuratibu mafunzo ya:
Kupunguza umaskini
UKIMWI
Dawa za kulevya
Usawa wa kijinsia
Kuhamasisha ushiriki wa jamii na kujitolea katika miradi ya maendeleo.
Kutoa elimu na uhamasishaji kuhusu ushiriki wa jamii katika maendeleo.
Kuhamasisha wananchi kushiriki katika:
kupanga
kufanya maamuzi
kutekeleza
kutathmini miradi ya maendeleo.
Kufanya tafiti kuhusu vikwazo vinavyozuia maendeleo ya jamii.
Sehemu hii inaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu (Officer in Charge).
2. Sehemu ya Uratibu wa NGOs na CBOs
( NGOs and CBOs Coordination Section )
Majukumu yake ni:
Kuratibu usajili wa NGOs na CBOs na kufuatilia shughuli zao katika maendeleo ya jamii.
Kuratibu utoaji wa elimu ya uraia kwa jamii.
Kuanzisha na kudumisha ushirikiano na taasisi na mashirika ya ndani na nje ya nchi yanayoshughulika na maendeleo ya jamii.
Kuratibu na kusimamia miradi ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Kusimamia utekelezaji wa mikataba inayohusiana na maendeleo ya jamii.
Kuandaa ripoti za mara kwa mara kuhusu maendeleo ya jamii.
Kusimamia na kudhibiti watoa huduma wa microfinance wa daraja la nne kwa kufuata maelekezo ya Bank of Tanzania.
Sehemu hii pia inaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu (Officer in Charge).

pages.menu_path: Administration > Division > Industry, Trade and Investments Division
pages.title: Industry, Trade and Investments Division
pages.text_en:
Objective
To provide a favorable business environment for industrialization, trade, marketing, and investment development.
Functions of the Division
The Division performs the following functions:
Coordinate the implementation of policies, laws, regulations, and procedures related to industry, trade, marketing, and investment.
Promote industrial development, trade, marketing, and investment within the Council.
Plan and develop industrial sites and industrial parks in collaboration with other stakeholders.
Plan incentives to promote industry, trade, marketing, and investment.
Promote the development of Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs).
Develop investment proposals and projects.
Promote measures for private sector development.
Establish and manage databases for industry, trade, marketing, and investment.
Oversee the management of one-stop business centers.
Conduct research on investment promotion.
Coordinate business forums.
Administer auction and market activities within the Council.
Implement business development strategies for small vendors and small business providers.
Provide a conducive environment for business and investment development.
Structure of the Division
The Division is led by a Head and consists of two (2) sections:
Industry Development and Investment Section
Trade and Marketing Section
Industry Development and Investment Section
This section performs the following activities:
Coordinate the implementation of policies, laws, regulations, and procedures in the industry and investment sectors.
Promote and coordinate the implementation of Public–Private Partnerships (PPP).
Allocate, develop, and monitor industrial sites and parks.
Provide advice on improving industrial policies and coordinate sector meetings.
Promote the production of various raw materials for industrial use.
Prepare and maintain registers of industries and investments.
Plan and estimate tariffs for small industries.
Develop and review the investment profile of the Council.
Promote private sector investment.
Coordinate and provide advice to investors.
Create a conducive environment for investment.
This section is led by an Officer in Charge .
Trade and Marketing Section
This section performs the following activities:
Supervise the implementation of trade and marketing policies, laws, rules, and regulations.
Provide entrepreneurial skills and training to the business community.
Coordinate and provide advice on trade registration activities.
Analyze trade and marketing reports and provide appropriate advice.
Coordinate District Business Council forums.
Promote public–private sector partnerships.
Administer auction and market activities in the Council.
Collect and distribute market information about goods and services to interested stakeholders.
Implement business development strategies for small vendors and small business providers.
Provide a conducive business environment.
This section is led by an Officer in Charge .
pages.text_sw:
Lengo
Kutoa mazingira mazuri ya biashara ili kukuza maendeleo ya viwanda, biashara, masoko na uwekezaji.
Majukumu ya Idara
Idara itatekeleza majukumu yafuatayo:
Kuratibu utekelezaji wa sera, sheria, kanuni na taratibu zinazohusiana na viwanda, biashara, masoko na uwekezaji.
Kukuza maendeleo ya viwanda, biashara, masoko na uwekezaji katika Halmashauri.
Kupanga na kuendeleza maeneo ya viwanda na bustani za viwanda kwa kushirikiana na wadau wengine muhimu.
Kupanga motisha (incentives) kwa ajili ya kukuza viwanda, biashara, masoko na uwekezaji.
Kukuza maendeleo ya Biashara Ndogo na za Kati (SMEs).
Kuandaa mapendekezo ya uwekezaji na miradi ya uwekezaji.
Kukuza hatua za maendeleo ya sekta binafsi.
Kuanzisha na kusimamia hifadhidata ya viwanda, biashara, masoko na uwekezaji.
Kusimamia uendeshaji wa vituo vya huduma za biashara sehemu moja (One Stop Business Centres).
Kufanya tafiti kuhusu uhamasishaji wa uwekezaji.
Kuratibu mikutano ya wafanyabiashara (Business Forums).
Kusimamia shughuli za minada na masoko katika Halmashauri.
Kutekeleza mkakati wa maendeleo ya biashara kwa wachuuzi wadogo na watoa huduma za biashara ndogo.
Kutoa mazingira rafiki kwa biashara na uwekezaji ili kukuza shughuli za biashara na uwekezaji.
Muundo wa Idara
Idara itaongozwa na Mkuu wa Idara na itakuwa na sehemu mbili (2) zifuatazo:
Sehemu ya Maendeleo ya Viwanda na Uwekezaji
Sehemu ya Biashara na Masoko
Sehemu ya Maendeleo ya Viwanda na Uwekezaji
Sehemu hii itafanya shughuli zifuatazo:
Kuratibu utekelezaji wa sera, sheria, kanuni na taratibu za sekta ya viwanda na uwekezaji.
Kukuza na kuratibu utekelezaji wa ushirikiano kati ya sekta ya umma na sekta binafsi (Public Private Partnership – PPP).
Kugawa, kuendeleza na kufuatilia maeneo ya viwanda na bustani za viwanda.
Kutoa ushauri kuhusu kuboresha sera za viwanda na kuratibu mikutano ya sekta husika.
Kukuza uzalishaji wa malighafi mbalimbali kwa ajili ya matumizi ya viwandani.
Kuandaa na kutunza rejista za viwanda na uwekezaji.
Kupanga na kukadiria ushuru kwa viwanda vidogo.
Kuandaa na kupitia wasifu wa uwekezaji (investment profile).
Kukuza uwekezaji wa sekta binafsi.
Kuratibu na kutoa ushauri kwa wawekezaji.
Kuunda mazingira mazuri kwa ajili ya uwekezaji.
Sehemu hii itaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu (Officer in Charge).
Sehemu ya Biashara na Masoko
Sehemu hii itafanya shughuli zifuatazo:
Kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria, kanuni na taratibu za biashara na masoko.
Kutoa mafunzo ya ujasiriamali kwa jamii ya wafanyabiashara.
Kuratibu na kutoa ushauri kuhusu usajili wa biashara.
Kuchambua taarifa za biashara na masoko na kutoa ushauri unaofaa.
Kuratibu mikutano ya Baraza la Biashara la Wilaya (District Business Council).
Kukuza ushirikiano kati ya sekta ya umma na sekta binafsi.
Kusimamia shughuli za minada na masoko katika Halmashauri.
Kukusanya na kusambaza taarifa za masoko ya bidhaa na huduma kwa wadau husika.
Kutekeleza mkakati wa maendeleo ya biashara kwa wachuuzi wadogo na watoa huduma za biashara ndogo.
Kutoa mazingira mazuri ya biashara.
Sehemu hii itaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu.

pages.menu_path: Administration > Division > Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries Division
pages.title: Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries Division
pages.text_en:
Objective
To promote the transformation and development of agriculture, irrigation, livestock, and fisheries so that these sectors contribute effectively to economic and community development.
Functions of the Division
The division performs the following functions:
Policy Implementation
Analyze, interpret, and supervise the implementation of policies, laws, and regulations related to agriculture, irrigation, livestock, and fisheries.
Standards and Pricing
Propose standards and prices for products and services produced in agriculture, livestock, and fisheries.
Planning
Prepare short-term and long-term plans and programs for the development of agriculture, irrigation, livestock, and fisheries.
Cooperative Development
Oversee the promotion and proper management of cooperatives within the council.
Technical Support
Provide technical advice to stakeholders involved in agriculture, irrigation, livestock, and fisheries.
Reporting
Prepare reports concerning activities in agriculture, irrigation, livestock, and fisheries.
Revenue Management
Supervise the collection and control of revenue generated from agriculture, irrigation, livestock, and fisheries activities.
Structure of the Division
The division is led by a Head of Division and consists of three sections:
Agriculture Section
Livestock Section
Fisheries Section
Each section is led by an Officer in Charge .
1. Agriculture Section
This section performs the following activities:
Prepare and implement programs for fertilizer supply at different sales points.
Prepare programs for distribution and storage of agricultural inputs.
Conduct soil testing of farmers’ field samples and provide advice.
Advise farmers on post-harvest handling, agro-processing, and value addition.
Estimate crop yield and production of important crops.
Conduct agricultural statistics and census work.
Carry out demonstration trials such as crop variety trials and fertilizer trials.
Promote and supervise agricultural cooperatives.
Coordinate fertilizer and plant protection supplies at the village level.
Organize farmer training programs at the village level.
Prepare and implement crop diversification plans, especially in irrigated areas.
Implement the Biogas Development Program.
Plan, design, construct, and maintain irrigation schemes.
Facilitate the formation of irrigators’ organizations.
Support the development and enforcement of irrigation by-laws.
Provide support services to farmers in irrigation schemes.
The section is led by an Officer in Charge .
2. Livestock Section
This section performs the following activities:
Interpret and supervise the implementation of livestock policies, laws, and regulations.
Prepare short-term and long-term plans for livestock development.
Evaluate the conservation and use of livestock resources.
Promote and supervise livestock cooperatives.
Provide technical support to livestock stakeholders.
Coordinate and supervise livestock development projects.
The section is led by an Officer in Charge .
3. Fisheries Section
This section performs the following activities:
Interpret and supervise the implementation of fisheries policies, laws, and regulations.
Prepare short-term and long-term plans for fisheries resource development.
Evaluate the conservation and use of fisheries resources.
Promote and supervise fisheries cooperatives.
Provide technical support to stakeholders in the fisheries sector.
Coordinate and supervise fisheries development projects.
The section is also led by an Officer in Charge .
pages.text_sw:
Lengo
Lengo la idara hii ni kuendeleza na kuboresha sekta za kilimo, umwagiliaji, mifugo na uvuvi ili kuchangia maendeleo ya uchumi na ustawi wa jamii.
Majukumu ya Idara
Idara itafanya majukumu yafuatayo:
Utekelezaji wa Sera
Kuchambua, kutafsiri na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria na kanuni zinazohusu kilimo, umwagiliaji, mifugo na uvuvi.
Viwango na Bei
Kupendekeza viwango na bei za bidhaa na huduma zinazotokana na kilimo, mifugo na uvuvi.
Mipango ya Maendeleo
Kuandaa mipango na programu za muda mfupi na muda mrefu kwa ajili ya maendeleo ya kilimo, umwagiliaji, mifugo na uvuvi.
Usimamizi wa Vyama vya Ushirika
Kusimamia na kuhamasisha uanzishaji na uendeshaji mzuri wa vyama vya ushirika katika halmashauri.
Ushauri wa Kitaalamu
Kutoa ushauri wa kitaalamu kwa wadau wa kilimo, umwagiliaji, mifugo na uvuvi.
Uandaaji wa Taarifa
Kuandaa taarifa kuhusu shughuli za kilimo, umwagiliaji, mifugo na uvuvi.
Usimamizi wa Mapato
Kusimamia ukusanyaji na udhibiti wa mapato yanayotokana na shughuli za kilimo, umwagiliaji, mifugo na uvuvi.
Muundo wa Idara
Idara inaongozwa na Mkuu wa Idara na ina sehemu tatu kuu:
Sehemu ya Kilimo
Sehemu ya Mifugo
Sehemu ya Uvuvi
Kila sehemu inaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu (Officer in Charge) .
1. Sehemu ya Kilimo
Sehemu hii hufanya shughuli zifuatazo:
Kuandaa na kutekeleza programu za usambazaji wa mbolea katika vituo mbalimbali vya mauzo.
Kuandaa programu za usambazaji na uhifadhi wa pembejeo za kilimo.
Kufanya uchunguzi wa udongo kutoka mashamba ya wakulima na kutoa ushauri.
Kutoa ushauri kwa wakulima kuhusu:
Utunzaji wa mazao baada ya kuvuna
Usindikaji wa mazao
Kuongeza thamani ya mazao
Kukadiria uzalishaji na mavuno ya mazao muhimu.
Kufanya takwimu na sensa za kilimo.
Kufanya majaribio ya mazao na mbolea (demonstration trials).
Kusimamia na kuhamasisha vyama vya ushirika wa wakulima.
Kuratibu upatikanaji wa mbolea na dawa za mimea katika vijiji.
Kuandaa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika ngazi ya kijiji.
Kuandaa na kutekeleza mpango wa mseto wa mazao, hasa katika maeneo ya umwagiliaji.
Kutekeleza programu ya maendeleo ya biogas.
Kupanga, kubuni, kujenga na kutunza miradi ya umwagiliaji.
Kusaidia kuanzisha vyama vya watumiaji wa umwagiliaji.
Kusaidia kutunga na kusimamia kanuni za umwagiliaji.
Kutoa huduma za usaidizi kwa wakulima katika miradi ya umwagiliaji.
Sehemu hii inaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu .
2. Sehemu ya Mifugo
Sehemu hii hufanya shughuli zifuatazo:
Kutafsiri na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria na kanuni za mifugo.
Kuandaa mipango ya muda mfupi na mrefu ya maendeleo ya mifugo.
Kutathmini uhifadhi na matumizi ya rasilimali za mifugo.
Kusimamia na kuhamasisha vyama vya ushirika wa wafugaji.
Kutoa msaada wa kitaalamu kwa wadau wa sekta ya mifugo.
Kuratibu na kusimamia miradi ya maendeleo ya mifugo.
Sehemu hii inaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu .
3. Sehemu ya Uvuvi
Sehemu hii hufanya shughuli zifuatazo:
Kutafsiri na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria na kanuni za uvuvi.
Kuandaa mipango ya muda mfupi na mrefu ya maendeleo ya rasilimali za uvuvi.
Kutathmini uhifadhi na matumizi ya rasilimali za uvuvi.
Kusimamia na kuhamasisha vyama vya ushirika wa wavuvi.
Kutoa msaada wa kitaalamu kwa wadau wa sekta ya uvuvi.
Kuratibu na kusimamia miradi ya maendeleo ya uvuvi.
Sehemu hii pia inaongozwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu .

pages.menu_path: Administration > Division > Infrastructure, Rural, and Urban Development Division
pages.title: Infrastructure, Rural, and Urban Development Division
pages.text_en:
Objective:
To supervise and provide guidance on all infrastructure-related matters in the Council.
Functions of the Division:
Advise on matters related to the construction industry.
Plan the development of infrastructure.
Analyze and recommend payments for contractor claims.
Inspect construction works undertaken by the Council to ensure quality.
Issue certificates to contractors upon completion of contracts.
Collaborate with TARURA to undertake road paving.
Establish and maintain cooperation with domestic and international institutions dealing with infrastructure.
Facilitate the resolution of land-use conflicts.
Manage urbanization in collaboration with the Ministry responsible for land.
Oversee rural and urban settlement development in collaboration with the Ministry responsible for land.
Structure of the Division:
The Division will be led by a Head and comprises the following three sections:
Works Section
Roads Section
Rural and Urban Development Section
Detailed Activities of Each Section:
1. Works Section
Advise on laws, regulations, and procedures related to construction.
Analyze, interpret, and manage the implementation of construction policies, laws, and regulations.
Prepare contracts for buildings and installations.
Estimate construction costs.
Monitor contractor performance.
Analyze and recommend contractor payment claims.
Inspect buildings to ensure quality.
Issue completion certificates for contractors.
Supervise operations of Council workshops.
2. Roads Section
Advise on identifying and paving new roads.
Analyze, interpret, and manage the implementation of road paving policies, laws, and regulations.
Pave new roads in surveyed land.
Prepare contracts for road paving projects.
Estimate costs for paving roads.
Monitor contractor performance.

Kusimamia na kutoa ushauri kuhusu masuala yote yanayohusiana na miundombinu katika Halmashauri.
Majukumu ya Idara:
Kutoa ushauri kuhusu masuala ya sekta ya ujenzi.
Kupanga maendeleo ya miundombinu.
Kuchambua na kutoa mapendekezo ya malipo kwa madai ya wakandarasi.
Kukagua kazi za ujenzi zinazofanywa na Halmashauri ili kuhakikisha ubora.
Kutoa vyeti kwa wakandarasi kwa kazi zilizokamilika.
Kushirikiana na TARURA katika upigaji wa barabara mpya.
Kuanzisha na kudumisha ushirikiano na taasisi za ndani na nje ya nchi zinazohusiana na miundombinu.
Kusaidia kutatua migogoro ya matumizi ya ardhi.
Kusimamia mchakato wa miji na ushirikiano na Wizara inayohusika na ardhi.
Kusimamia maendeleo ya makazi ya vijijini na mijini kwa kushirikiana na Wizara inayohusika na ardhi.
Muundo wa Idara:
Idara hii itasimamiwa na Mkuu wa Idara na itajumuisha sehemu tatu (3) zifuatazo:
Sehemu ya Kazi
Sehemu ya Barabara
Sehemu ya Maendeleo ya Vijijini na Miji
Majukumu ya Kila Sehemu:
1. Sehemu ya Kazi
Kutoa ushauri kuhusu sheria, kanuni, na taratibu zinazohusiana na ujenzi.
Kuchambua, kutafsiri, na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria, na kanuni za ujenzi.
Kuandaa mikataba ya ujenzi wa majengo na miundombinu.
Kukadiria gharama za ujenzi.
Kufuatilia utendaji wa wakandarasi.
Kuchambua na kutoa mapendekezo kuhusu madai ya malipo ya wakandarasi.
Kukagua majengo ili kuhakikisha ubora.
Kutoa vyeti kwa wakandarasi kwa kazi zilizokamilika.
Kusimamia shughuli za warsha za Halmashauri.
2. Sehemu ya Barabara
Kutoa ushauri kuhusu masuala ya utambuzi na upigaji wa barabara mpya.
Kuchambua, kutafsiri, na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria, na kanuni za ujenzi wa barabara.
Kupiga barabara mpya katika maeneo yaliyosajiliwa.
Kuandaa mikataba ya upigaji barabara.
Kukadiria gharama za kupiga barabara.
Kufuatilia utendaji wa wakandarasi.
Kuchambua na kutoa mapendekezo kuhusu madai ya malipo ya wakandarasi.
Kukagua barabara zilizopigwa ili kuhakikisha ubora.
Kusimamia ujenzi na matengenezo ya vituo vya mabasi.
3. Sehemu ya Maendeleo ya Vijijini na Miji
Kusimamia maendeleo ya makazi ya vijijini na mijini kwa kushirikiana na Wizara inayohusika na ardhi.
Kusimamia huduma za mazingira na kijamii.
Kuongoza mpango wa maendeleo ya mijini, makazi, na matumizi endelevu ya ardhi.
Kusimamia na kuratibu usimamizi wa urithi wa kihistoria na utalii.
Kusimamia mchakato wa miji kwa kushirikiana na Wizara inayohusika na ardhi.
Kusaidia na kuratibu miji inayochipuka kutoka vijiji na kuwa makazi ya miji.
Kusaidia kutatua migogoro ya matumizi ya ardhi.
Idara hii itasimamiwa na Mkuu wa Idara, na kila sehemu itasimamiwa na Afisa Mkuu wa Sehemu.
